title: Advance-Payment Reduction for Households with Several Children in Creek Kids Club
content:
**Schedule.** Under the multi-program household schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, an advance payment of Pre-K tuition is reduced by the number of the household's children holding a Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program enrollment in status active. Each such enrollment covers one child.

| Children of the household holding a Creek Kids Club enrollment in status active | Taken off the advance payment |
|---|---|
| three or more | 15.00 |
| exactly two | 10.00 |
| one or none | nothing |

Every active Creek Kids Club enrollment of the household counts, whatever its plan; a waitlisted or not yet active registration does not.

## Examples (hypothetical households)

- Four children in active Creek Kids Club care: 15.00 is taken off the advance payment.
- Two children, both in active Before & After-School Care (5 Days): 10.00 is taken off.
- One child in active Creek Kids Club care and a second whose registration is waitlisted: one counted, nothing is taken off.
